user.title: Magic Lights
user.description: Every area with lights becomes a room with its own scene select. Rooms, zones and scenes are set up in the Magic Lights panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Magic Lights is already set up.

scene_not_adapted.message: "{scene}" has no lights in {target} yet. Set it up in Magic Lights.

unknown_target.message: There is no room or zone {target_id}.

activate_scene.name: Activate scene
activate_scene.description: Runs a scene on a room or zone. Activating the running scene again brings back lights that were changed by hand.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness of the brightest light; the other lights keep their levels relative to it.

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Let palette scenes move through their colours, or hold them.

turn_off.name: Turn off
turn_off.description: Turns off every light of a room or zone.

toggle_scene.name: Toggle scene
toggle_scene.description: Turns a room or zone off if the scene is running there, otherwise activates it.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness of the brightest light; the other lights keep their levels relative to it.

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Let palette scenes move through their colours, or hold them.

next_scene.name: Next scene
next_scene.description: Activates the next scene of the menu; after the last one comes Off.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: Start over at the first scene after Off.

previous_scene.name: Previous scene
previous_scene.description: Activates the previous scene of the menu.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: Wrap around at the first scene.

adjust_brightness.name: Adjust brightness
adjust_brightness.description: Changes the brightness of the running scene, measured at its brightest light; the other lights follow in proportion.

step.name: Step
step.description: Percentage points to add or remove.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: New brightness of the brightest light.

set_dynamic.name: Set dynamic
set_dynamic.description: Plays or holds the colours of the running scene. Unlike activating the scene again, this leaves manual lights alone.

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Move through the colours, or hold them.

release.name: Release
release.description: Stops the scene without changing the lights; the status becomes Manual.

reclaim.name: Reclaim
reclaim.description: Brings lights that were changed by hand back into the running scene.

light.name: Light
light.description: Only this light; all of them when left out.
